description: Free. Active official warnings of the Deutscher Wetterdienst, counted by DWD level (1 Wetterwarnung, 2 markantes Wetter, 3 Unwetter, 4 extremes Unwetter) and by federal state, with the most frequent warning types and the level 3+ groups (state, type, number of districts, from-until). Optional state filter (name or short code, e.g. Hamburg or HH). DWD's levels and texts are passed through; Orb Studio adds no rating and no forecast. A warning area is a district or municipality, not a whole state. Source: Deutscher Wetterdienst.

state.description: Federal state name or short code, e.g. Hamburg or HH

name: get_dwd_warnings
title: Official German weather warnings now (DWD): by level and state, with the severe ones
